Create the following Go files for the plane-cli project. Follow the same patterns used in existing commands.

Read `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/project/project.go` first to understand the pattern, then create ALL of the following files:

1. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/page/page.go`
   - Commands: create, get, create-workspace, get-workspace
   - Project page: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/projects/{project_id}/pages/`
   - Workspace page: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/pages/`
   - Columns: ID, NAME(name), COLOR(color), ARCHIVED(is_archived)
   - create: --name (required), --description, --color
   - get: <page-id> arg
   - create-workspace: --name (required), --description, --color (uses workspace-level path)
   - get-workspace: <page-id> arg (uses workspace-level path)

2. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/intake/intake.go`
   - CRUD: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/projects/{project_id}/intakes/`
   - There's a sub-path for intake issues: `intakes/{intake_id}/intake-issues/`
   - Columns: ID, NAME(name), SOURCE(source), STATUS(status)
   - Create: --name (required), --source
   - Update: <intake-id>, --name, --status

3. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/worklog/worklog.go`
   - CRUD + total: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/projects/{project_id}/work-items/{issue_id}/worklogs/`
   - Total endpoint: `worklogs/total/`
   - Needs --issue flag for all commands
   - Columns: ID, DESCRIPTION(description), DURATION(duration), LOGGED_AT(logged_at)
   - Create: --issue (required), --duration (required, float64), --description, --logged-at
   - Update: <worklog-id>, --duration, --description
   - total: shows total time for --issue

4. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/initiative/initiative.go`
   - CRUD: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/initiatives/` (workspace-level, no project needed)
   - Only needs workspace, NOT project
   - Columns: ID, NAME(name), DESCRIPTION(description), STATUS(status)
   - Create: --name (required), --description
   - Update: <initiative-id>, --name, --description, --status

5. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/epic/epic.go`
   - Read-only (list, get): `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/projects/{project_id}/epics/`
   - Columns: ID, NAME(name), STATE(state), PRIORITY(priority)

6. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/customer/customer.go`
   - CRUD: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/customers/` (workspace-level)
   - Only needs workspace, NOT project
   - Columns: ID, NAME(name), EMAIL(email), DOMAIN(domain)
   - Create: --name (required), --email, --domain
   - Update: <customer-id>, --name, --email, --domain

7. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/teamspace/teamspace.go`
   - CRUD: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/teamspaces/` (workspace-level)
   - Only needs workspace, NOT project
   - Columns: ID, NAME(name), DESCRIPTION(description)
   - Create: --name (required), --description
   - Update: <teamspace-id>, --name, --description

8. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/sticky/sticky.go`
   - CRUD: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/stickies/` (workspace-level)
   - Only needs workspace, NOT project
   - Columns: ID, NAME(name), COLOR(color)
   - Create: --name (required), --description, --color
   - Update: <sticky-id>, --name, --description, --color

All use their own package name. Import paths:
- github.com/plane-cli/plane-cli/internal/api
- github.com/plane-cli/plane-cli/internal/cmdutil
- github.com/plane-cli/plane-cli/internal/output

Export: `func NewCmd(f *cmdutil.Factory) *cobra.Command`
